2610.07751.title: How Well Do LLMs Reason with Noisy Evidence? An Active Visual Reasoning Benchmark
2610.07751.paper_summary: Real-world reasoning rarely reduces to static question answering: agents must actively gather information from tools and sensors that are often noisy and unreliable. Yet most existing active reasoning benchmarks assume that environmental feedback is trustworthy, or introduce noise without exposing an explicit, calibrated uncertainty signal, leaving open how LLMs should reason when the evidence itself is uncertain. We introduce VisualNoiseQA, a novel benchmark for active reasoning under noisy visual feedback. A text-only LLM must solve VQA problems by iteratively querying a fixed, off-the-shelf VLM treated as a stochastic visual sensor. For each query, we draw multiple samples and expose an empirical uncertainty signal via self-consistency, enabling the reasoner to probe from different angles and decide what to ask next and when to stop. Our construction is automatic and scalable: starting from diverse VQA sources and two noisy VLMs, we retain only questions where the sensor is inconsistent yet human-solvable. We evaluate multiple LLM reasoners on 1,000 instances spanning perception, chart understanding, and knowledge-intensive reasoning. VisualNoiseQA thus provides a controlled playground to study how different LLMs exploit uncertainty signals for robust reasoning.
2610.07751.paper_summary_zh: 現實世界的推理很少簡化為靜態的問題回答：代理必須主動從工具和傳感器中收集信息，而這些工具和傳感器通常是嘈雜且不可靠的。<lb/>然而，大多數現有的主動推理基準假設環境反饋是可信的，或者引入噪聲而不暴露明確的、經過校準的不確定性信號，這使得大型語言模型在證據本身不確定的情況下如何推理成為一個未解決的問題。<lb/>我們引入了VisualNoiseQA，一個在嘈雜視覺反饋下進行主動推理的新基準。<lb/>一個僅限文本的大型語言模型必須通過反覆查詢一個固定的、現成的視覺語言模型來解決視覺問答問題，該模型被視為隨機視覺傳感器。<lb/>對於每個查詢，我們抽取多個樣本，並通過自我一致性暴露出經驗不確定性信號，使推理者能夠從不同角度探查並決定接下來要問什麼以及何時停止。<lb/>我們的構建是自動化和可擴展的：從多樣的視覺問答來源和兩個嘈雜的視覺語言模型開始，我們僅保留傳感器不一致但人類可解的問題。<lb/>我們在1,000個涵蓋感知、圖表理解和知識密集型推理的實例上評估多個大型語言模型推理者。<lb/>因此，VisualNoiseQA提供了一個受控的實驗場，以研究不同的大型語言模型如何利用不確定性信號進行穩健的推理。
